"PW_Group_20261021_084754_w3r0462pe4" is priced Free and rendered as "Free to Follow", so it cannot be joined — but PG-01 proved this leader's Stripe IS connected, and a $0 group on a payable leader is still supposed to charge the member $3/month. Check the leader's hosting plan first (a lapsed plan makes every group of theirs follow-only regardless of price), then their Earnings/withdrawal setup.
MEMBER: FREE group offers Join, not Follow
Join CTA should be visible in side panel getByTestId('group-side-panel').locator('button, a, [role="button"]').filter({ hasText: /Join|Interested|Get|Subscribe|Pay|Activate/i }).first()
The join CTA should read "Join Group" on a group priced Free. It read "Join Group". The label does not vary by pricing model — if it now does, the product changed.

A group priced Free should show "$3/month" beside its join CTA (its price plus the $3 platform fee). The member saw "$3/month" — either the leader's pricing is not reaching them, or the price display changed again.
MEMBER: FREE group discloses the $3 fee in the side panel (reported)
Side panel should offer the "Show platform fee details" affordance beside the price getByTestId('group-side-panel').getByLabel('Show platform fee details').first()

Hovering "Show platform fee details" should show the platform fee tooltip ("Includes the $3/month MentalHappy platform fee") — the only place the member learns what the price includes getByRole('tooltip').filter({ hasText: 'Includes the $3/month MentalHappy platform fee' }).first()
MEMBER: FREE join routes to checkout - a $0 group is still a money path
Join CTA should be visible in side panel getByTestId('group-side-panel').locator('button, a, [role="button"]').filter({ hasText: /Join|Interested|Get|Subscribe|Pay|Activate/i }).first()

steps.name: Join on "PW_Group_20261021_084754_w3r0462pe4" led nowhere — still at /groups/pw_group_20261021_084754_w3r0462pe4/subscribe. Expected either the checkout (/groups/pw_group_20261021_084754_w3r0462pe4/subscribe) or the group page (/groups/pw_group_20261021_084754_w3r0462pe4).

A group priced Free must still route the member to checkout, because the $3 platform fee is charged on top of a $0 group price. Landing on the group page instead means the fee was not collected — either the product changed, or free groups stopped being a money path. Re-check the leader's pricing page: its Live Preview is what settled this ("Your Price $0.00 / Platform Monthly Fee $3.00 / Total Member Pays $3.00/month").
MEMBER: FREE checkout charges exactly 3, then pays
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/ways to join this group have changed/i).or(getByText(/step away|Summary/i).first()).first()
Checkout should disclose the "Platform fee/month" line getByText('Platform fee/month', { exact: true }).first()
Checkout should show the platform fee value "$3.00" getByText('$3.00', { exact: true }).first()
Could not read the "Total" amount from the checkout summary

"Total" ($3) minus the group fee ($0) should equal the $3 platform fee — the fee is disclosed but the total does not add it up. A group fee of $0 here means the summary showed no "Group fee" row, which is expected on a FREE group and a defect on a priced one.

The checkout's full-page "Loading..." overlay was still showing after 45s. No user could pay through it. Check first that nothing clicked Pay Now before the card was filled (an empty submit raises this overlay); if nothing did, it is the app — keep the trace for dev. getByText('Loading...', { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })

Stripe's card form was still loading after 30s. Check the trace's Network tab for slow js.stripe.com downloads before suspecting the app — see Troubleshooting #30. locator('iframe[title="Secure payment input frame"]:not([aria-hidden="true"])').contentFrame().locator('[autocomplete="cc-number"]').or(locator('input[name="cardnumber"]')).first()
